decks.notes: This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays and constant pressure using Rakdos creatures and removal spells. The deck aims to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. Strong creature threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Blade of the Oni provide a constant threat to the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes land destruction with cards like Torch the Tower to keep the opponent off balance.

This Red Deck Wins Pioneer deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, while using burn spells like Skewer the Critics and Wizard's Lightning to deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck's strategy is to keep up pressure on the opponent by efficiently using low-cost spells like Play with Fire and Monstrous Rage, while also having utility lands like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear for additional damage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and burn spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence by ramping with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, then using Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Leyline of the Guildpact to generate massive amounts of green mana. This mana is then used to cast powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns, while also enabling the devotion to green required for cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Ulvenwald Oddity. Storm the Festival and Invasion of Ixalan provide additional ways to find key creatures, creating a fast and aggressive ramp deck focused on green devotion.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells. By combining efficient threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Mutavault with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, it aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while eliminating key threats. The inclusion of powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional late-game options for dominating the battlefield. With strong mana fixing and a mix of disruption and aggression, this deck is designed to keep opponents on the back foot and push for a fast victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the board through a combination of powerful enchantments and creatures, while utilizing the Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently tutor for the right threats or answers. The deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ultimately grinding them out until victory. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as an additional tool for card advantage and flexibility in this midrange control deck, ensuring that the player has a constant stream of threats and answers at their disposal.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergy and recursive creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Scavenger's Talent and Deadly Dispute to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn, along with powerful finishers like Ygra, Eater of All and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruption spells to apply constant pressure on the opponent. By combining efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize with powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to maintain board control while dealing direct damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Mutavault and Blade of the Oni further enhances the aggressive strategy, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out provide additional card advantage and push for a fast win.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent. With a combination of efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with powerful pump spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Reckless Rage and Fatal Push provide removal options to clear the way for your creatures while cards like Claim / Fame and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance offer utility and additional reach. The deck aims to close out games swiftly with a combination of speed and power.

This deck focuses on filling up the graveyard with card draw spells to quickly bring back Arclight Phoenix for repeated attacks. It also uses disruptive spells like Lightning Axe and Spikefield Hazard to control the board and protect its aggressive strategy. The inclusion of cards like Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster further enhances the graveyard synergy, while cards like Brazen Borrower provide versatility for different matchups. With a mix of fast threats and graveyard recursion, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with constant pressure and efficient plays.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a wide range of spells and abilities to disrupt opponent's strategy while ensuring card advantage. The deck incorporates Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control tool, allowing the player to access a variety of cards from different colors. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells, ramp cards, and versatile threats to handle various threats from the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility in managing the game state.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive tactics with a combination of fast creatures and disruption spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with efficient threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross while using cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to close out the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and hand disruption.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, using cards like Emberheart Challenger, Monastery Swiftspear, and Heartfire Hero to deal damage quickly. The deck also includes cards like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage for removal and disruption. By applying constant pressure and utilizing efficient creatures and spells, this deck aims to win the game swiftly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to consistently deploy threats and close out games.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of low-cost creatures and burn spells to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The key strategy is to flood the board with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, while using cards like Monstrous Rage and Reckless Rage to deal damage to both creatures and the opponent's life total. Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional damage sources, while cards like Fatal Push and Claim / Fame offer removal and recursion options. The deck aims to win the game swiftly by overwhelming the opponent with aggressive threats.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying efficient threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. By playing efficient creatures like Aven Interrupter and Archon of Emeria, along with disruptive spells like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and often. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent and fast mana development, allowing the deck to deploy threats on curve and force the opponent to react quickly or risk falling behind. The deck blends aggression with disruption to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on early disruption and control using cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes strong aggro creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Floodpits Drowner to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck has a mix of threats and answers, with an emphasis on disrupting the opponent's hand and board while deploying powerful creatures to end the game swiftly. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and enable smooth gameplay.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice strategies to gain value from creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn. The deck aims to control the board through sacrificing creatures and generating incremental advantages, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a combination of damage and disruption. Additionally, the deck utilizes lands that provide flexibility in terms of mana fixing and utility, allowing for a smooth and consistent gameplay experience.
